In December 1973, two months after the resignation of vice president Agnew, Ford was appointed to the vice presidency, becoming the first person appointed to become vice president under the terms of the twenty-fifth amendment. Domestically, Ford presided over the worst economy in the four decades since the Great Depression, with growing inflation and a recession.
